description: Change repos/stateful-ui-vessel/src/index.ts so the uiPanel_write and uiQuestion_write branch of its /resolve handler stops destroying live panels. Three changes in this order, because the first is a precondition for the second. First, replace the nullish-coalescing field defaults with Object.hasOwn checks: each of title, body, kind, importance, asks and visibility must be taken from the pointer only when the pointer actually carries that key, and otherwise fall back to the value already stored on the existing panel, with the literal defaults such as "Untitled" applying only when the panel is genuinely being created. An explicitly supplied empty string must still clear the field, which is exactly what the current nullish-coalescing form cannot express. Second, refuse a write that carries no content-bearing key at all over a panel that already exists, returning an error naming the contentlessness rather than silently rewriting the record with defaults, so a caller sees non-progress instead of a green no-op. Third, stop coercing a non-string body with String(): either preserve a structured body as supplied or reject it explicitly, because coercing an object to the text "[object Object]" while returning resolved true is silent destruction of a human's content. Do not change the read handlers, the discovery registration, or the persistence format. The existing behaviour is that a defaulted write of only a type and an id over a populated panel returns success and leaves the title as "Untitled", the body empty and the asks gone.
